description: Change a live agent's name, greeting, prompts, voice, model, call length or call transfer through the approval-gated path, for changes made on the owner's behalf that need a recorded approval. Needs agent_id, at least one field to change and the owner's confirmed approval. Callers hear the change on their next call. Direct edits by the owner go through update_agent_config. Returns needs_user_input, needs_approval, pending_approval, executed, denied or unsupported; only executed means the change was made.

actor.description: Do not set. Kept for older clients; the signed-in connection identifies you.

authority.description: Do not set. It cannot approve a change: the owner approves through review_url or by being signed in.

business_id.description: Business ID. Required when the token can reach more than one business.

dry_run.description: Check access, inputs and approval without making the change.

extraction_schema.description: Fields to capture from each call.

idempotency_key.description: Required to make the change. Repeating a key returns the first outcome instead of running the change again.

queue_for_approval.description: When approval is missing, create a pending approval the owner can accept in the dashboard instead of returning needs_approval.

reason.description: Why the change is being made; kept in the audit log.

source_ref.description: Optional reference for the request, such as a ticket or automation run ID.

transfer_enabled.description: Whether the agent may transfer calls to a person.

voice.description: Voice to use, from list_voices: { provider, voiceId }.

voice_catalog_id.description: Voice to use: an id from list_voices. Preferred over voice.

name: request_agent_update
title: Request Agent Change With Approval
